ltvGrid.note: N/A = ineligible cell (no priced LTV). Rows are (loan tier, FICO). Foreign National is its own FICO-independent row within the <=1.5M tier.

overlays.propertyTypes: SFR, PUD, Townhome (Row Homes Ineligible), 2-4 Units, Condos & Non-Warrantable Condos (Max 80% LTV)
overlays.shortTermRentals: Property Guard report required; Min DSCR 1.15x; 5% LTV reduction vs matrix (75% Max); Min FICO 720; No First Time Investor / 2+ Unit / Rural / Unique Properties
overlays.maxCashOutAmount: $1,000,000 (overlays apply); cash-out may be used towards reserves
overlays.dscrDefinition: Gross Rents / PITIA (fully amortizing) or Gross Rents / ITIA (interest only)
overlays.smallLoan: Loan < $125,000: Max LTV reduced to 75%; Loan < $100k delegated delivery only
overlays.firstTimeInvestor: Min DSCR 1.00, Min FICO 700, Long-Term Rental Only
overlays.firstTimeHomebuyer: Not Eligible unless 2+ borrowers and at least one is not a FTHB
overlays.eligibleBorrowers: 12-month history of investment property ownership in most recent 12 months
overlays.geographicLimits: Philadelphia, PA: Max LTV reduced by 10% all occupancies
overlays.ineligibleGeos: HI lava zones 1 & 2; Baltimore City, MD
overlays.citizenship: US Citizens; Permanent Resident Aliens; Non-Permanent Resident Aliens (w/ US Credit); Foreign Nationals (Min DSCR 1.00x)
